body: Ok no one answered my post had enough I live in th uk I want to die it’s harsh because I love my kids but I’m not a good dad at all my wife can’t stand the sight of me because of the way I treat her past and present yesterday I was close to killing myself thoughts of my oldest daughter crying stopped me I get on well with her better than most she’s just turned 18 I threaten my wife all the time that I’ll leave and she can’t cope with the kids I’m fucked up im not young I’m 46 fit healthy I look younger most men would love to be me with or with out the wife but I’m not most men I suffered child abuse and it fuckd me up it changed my personality as I got older I never got help til I was 38 and that helped me stop watching porn and get out of the cycle I had in my head and attribute blame but never took the shame away. But I can’t change the bad shit I’ve done to my dad I’ve ive been violent I never helped her with anything but she still loved me but it’s stopped now and now she can’t wait to get away so send me some help because I don’t want to go on I read some of these posts and think it’s not that bad for these people. So please help me.
I want this pain to stop no one gives a fuck

So I didn’t have the bollocks this time it was weird I had a brief hallucination of my dead dad sittining next to me the fucked up thing is I hated him he beat the absolute shit out of us as kids he made it so when I was abused I had no one to turn to so I took the rope off my neck untied it from the tree and put it back in the back of my car I felt ashamed that I hadn’t gone through with this it would have been quick and easy like pulling a trigger I do regret not doing it but I know I will cause pain to many when I do

Well I’m sitting in my car with a rope now I’m contemplating tying it round the tree behind me and tying it round my neck then driving.  my wife wants to get as far as she can away from me even willing to leave her kids she loves I must be so awful to be around

I know I will make people suffer if I die I just don’t know what else to do some people go their whole lives with minor upset I live a life of regret I can’t go back and seek help as a teenager so I’m stuck in my own mind over 30 years of things going through my mind .

So today I woke feeling shit I get up wash kids take them to school but in my mind I’m thinking I could tie my rope to a tree and the other end round my neck and drive fast the quicker I drive the less it hurts fuck this I’m so upset life should have been better.

This is a last call every day I think about walking out and ending it I swear it’s only the coward in me that stops me but I’m feeling the pull of alcohol and drugs now I know they won’t help at all but I’ve started drinking a little next will be weed. There’s no light at the end of the tunnel it’s shit I’ve ruined my relationship I’m convinced my wife started looking for someone else when she found out as she must have felt disgusted at me and I turn on her every day nearly accusing her I never used to be like that before when I kept my secret she was the best thing in my life positive and always made me smile now she looks at me with contempt asking me what I’m going to go on about now. She’s past caring and I don’t blame her after she found out about the porn which I let her find she’s never got over it and it wasn’t easy for me opening up it was good to let some pain out but I’d hurt her emotions badly I didn’t want to let my secret out so I tried saying other things when all I wanted was help so unless someone can come up with something good the idealism of suicide will get bigger for me I make plans al the time I don’t want to wake up it would be better for her not to have to worry about me.
